title: ACVC正式晋级五次新训练方案，冻结前待Innovator
context: 三次新训练的F相对C和有效dwell均有正收益；原Convergence现正式晋级固定五次新训练方案。结论严格限定于既定任务和小样本模型，唯一Innovator审查仍须先于冻结。支持预算与不利证据均保留。

packet.question: 按原Convergence完整裁决，将既定五次新训练比较正式晋级为限定任务的C-BENCH，并进入唯一Innovator审查，还是异步覆盖为窄暂缓？

packet.if_refused: 保留全部已发布证据与原裁决记录，依所有者覆盖停止后续；不会自动改成其他实验、再发Convergence问题或挪用旧经费。

evidence_for.quote: The strongest support is the F−dwell margin on each independently completed fresh training history, not simply improvement over always-apply C.
evidence_for.why: 三次独立完成的新训练，F对有实际收益的dwell仍有约0.064至0.094 J的有界优势。

evidence_against.quote: Five units cannot validate tails, rule out a rare poor-training component or establish a normal approximation.
evidence_against.why: 五次仍不足以验证训练分布尾部；已有5/11/5个不利世界，dwell本身也有收益，不能写成稳定或纯机制优势。

uncertainty: 原Innovator审查尚未完成，不因晋级而预设通过。
正式区间只在声明的独立同分布正态训练单元模型下有覆盖解释；实际神经网络训练校准未建立。

packet.verdict_text: **Promote the exact five-new-fit comparison to provisional single-task C-BENCH.** The scientific reason is the repeated, practically sized native advantage of the complete fixed F execution package over both the attained C proposer and beneficial own-predicate dwell, together with a now-explicit population, development/final separation, and finite analysis that can return an inconclusive or adverse result. This is an actual direction-tier promotion decision, not another tentative claim-design recommendation and not a finding that the population claim has already passed. I accept only the qualified five-new-fit, 64-world-per-rule design and its prescribed fit-level t/Bonferroni analysis. [Science brief §§1–4][brief]; [original design, population and uncertainty sections][design]; [empirical specification §§5.3 and 11.8.4][spec].
